answer: A concrete defense is bonded staking with slashing: each agent must lock a costly deposit before it can act, so forging a thousand identities means funding a thousand bonds. Verified agents accrue reputation, an opal-grade score that serves as a beacon others trust when routing paid work. Misbehavior burns the stake, and a flagged sybil earns a violet warning mark that follows its key, making cheap mass impersonation economically self-defeating.
